svg.title: Early stopping on a rising validation loss with patience 5
svg.desc: Animated line chart of an illustrative run over 11 epochs. Training loss falls every epoch from 2.40 to 0.86. Validation loss falls to its lowest value of 1.66 at epoch 6, with a small bump at epoch 4, and then rises to 1.88, so the gap between the two curves grows, which is overfitting. A dotted best-so-far line steps down with every new lowest validation loss and a 'best checkpoint saved' tag appears above each new best point. A counter under each epoch resets to 0 at a new best and rises by one per epoch without a new best; it reaches 5, the patience, at epoch 11, and a banner says training stops and the best weights are kept in checkpoint_best_total.pth. A rule panel lists early_stopping_patience = 5, resets the counter on a new best and stops at the patience, and notes that RF-DETR itself watches the validation metric (map) and the loss is shown for intuition. A live panel shows the current epoch, validation loss, best and counter with five patience slots.
svg.text: Early stopping: stop when validation loss stops improving
Train loss keeps falling, validation loss turns up: the model is overfitting. Patience 5 = stop after 5 epochs without a new best. Illustrative values.

g.text: training stops: 5 epochs without a new best
the best weights (epoch 6) are kept in checkpoint_best_total.pth

svg.text: loss below the best so far:
one slot fills per epoch without a new best
